config.hypothesis: Realized inspection prevents invalid/duplicate credit and provides bounded noncausal QA without score regression on fixed public workloads.

datasets.name: normal-b and 180-night/6000-target long-held
datasets.version: frozen official v4 and prior generated cards
datasets.identity: per-run full input SHA256 manifests; no runtime engine truth reads

random.rng: agent deterministic, inputs pre-generated and frozen
random.stream_policy: same fixed truth/weather/catalogue per paired run; CPU adaptation can alter paths

parallel.backend: independent host processes across cards; serial agent/scorer per run

environment.software: bundled Python3.12.14 stdlib, C++17, frozen official workflow and process CPU hook

controls.sample_ids: fixed public target IDs per card; own observe indices in audit
controls.selection: Two fixed paired workloads; no score tuning; D1 unavailable. Timed adaptive paths may differ. Initial candidate long scored lower; preserve and report it. Added QA-only replay-credit correction after finding that a surviving exposure can recover marginal credit when an earlier high score is invalidated. Recheck final source, not select the best run.
controls.units_and_coordinates: UTC/degrees; normalized standard CPU and raw host CPU kept separate
controls.bin_edges_and_denominator: one official total per card and algorithm

paired_scores.definition: official totals and counts for baseline and candidate normal-b/long-held
paired_scores.uncertainty: single fixed pair each; no variance estimate

tests.definition: passed regression and fixed visit checks

zip_valid.definition: fresh extraction build JSONL and fallback

reproducibility.tolerance: recorded action traces/score files exact; timed adaptive reruns can differ

config.success_criterion: complete legal episodes without mistaking engine/model waits for own CPU; test/build/protocol pass; report score tradeoffs

budget.stop_condition: four initial runs plus exact-final normal-b/long-held after QA replay credit correction; no score tuning

git.limitation: 无 git commit；需外部源码快照，不能仅靠登记复现

limitations: 登记不验证命令曾被执行、数据 identity 或用户声明的实际运行环境
源码/输入/输出必须在登记期间保持不变；登记锁不锁实验进程
默认输出 size/mtime 不能验证内容；--hash-outputs 对普通文件保存 SHA256
输出符号链接只记录目标，不捕获目标内容
